rules.hierarchy: H1: text-5xl to text-6xl tracking-tight font-bold, H2: text-3xl font-semibold, Body: text-base text-gray-300 tracking-wide

layouts.streaming_feed: Netflix-style horizontal scrolling containers with gap-6. Large cinematic hero banners.
layouts.studio_dashboard: Complex BENTO grid, tight gap-4. Tool sidebar on left, main generation canvas centered, generation history right/bottom.
layouts.reels: Full viewport height scrolling snap-y mandatory, right-aligned floating actions.
layouts.navigation: Sticky top glassmorphism navbar (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10). Hidden on reels view.

ui_components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Primary action uses gradient background (from-pink-500 to-blue-600) with hover:brightness-110 transition. Secondary buttons use bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10.
ui_components.cards: Dark base (bg-[#141414]) with 1px border-white/5. Hover state: -translate-y-1 shadow-lg shadow-black/50 border-white/10.
ui_components.inputs: Shadcn input components customized to bg-black/40 border-white/10 text-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500.
ui_components.glass_surfaces: Use for floating panels or tooltips: bg-[#141414]/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10.

specific_flows.ai_generation_studio: Include a robust left sidebar for settings (Model selection: Flux.1, Wan 2.2, Qwen, Sarvam). Display user credit balance prominently in the header. The main canvas should show real-time generation status with sleek skeleton loaders.
specific_flows.streaming_feed: Horizontal carousels divided by categories (Movies, Web Series, Books, Reels). Must feel like Netflix but dedicated to AI content.
specific_flows.pricing_page: Prominent display of tiers. Show '40% Profit' metrics visually for creators. Use a glassmorphism card for the premium tier to make it stand out.
specific_flows.payment_gateway: Show a clear manual UPI QR code (Payment number: 9673856312, App name: VEDED). Integrate a placeholder for Razorpay button.
specific_flows.bookstream_upload: Drag-and-drop file uploader zone with subtle dashed border and active state. Clear fields for metadata (Title, Category, Price/Free).

motion.hover_states: Buttons and cards should lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and increase brightness/shadows.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in on load using Framer Motion (opacity: 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0).
motion.loading: Use pulsing skeletons (animate-pulse) with dark gray backgrounds (bg-white/10) for streaming feed placeholders.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets 4.5:1 ratio. Off-white (#F0F0F0) on deep gray (#0A0A0A) provides excellent legibility.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:outline-none).
accessibility.test_ids: Every button, input, and card MUST have a data-testid attribute for automated testing.

libraries_and_tools.icons: lucide-react for standard UI icons, iconoir-react for more creative, distinctive line icons.
libraries_and_tools.animations: framer-motion for layout transitions and micro-interactions.
libraries_and_tools.components: shadcn/ui for complex forms, select, and dialogs. Use sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Video generated successfully').

instructions_to_main_agent: Design for pure Dark Mode. VEDED is a premium cinematic app.
Do NOT use pure white (#FFFFFF) for text; use #F0F0F0.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000); use #0A0A0A for the deepest background.
Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions, but heavily customize their background and border colors to fit the dark cinematic theme.
Do NOT center align the app container. Respect natural reading flow.
Never use AI emoji placeholders. Use proper lucide-react icons.
Ensure the Reels section is mobile-first, taking up full height with snapping.
For the Studio Dashboard, ensure tight spacing (gap-4) and visible skeleton loaders for the image/video generation queue.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or crisp rounded) with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
NEVER use generic placeholder URLs for images.
